query_normalized: evaluating the statistical validity of crowdsourced labels statistics
rationale: The paper discusses the general philosophy of statistical inference and pragmatism but does not measure, analyze, or provide empirical baselines for the specific validity of crowdsourced labels or the statistical properties of crowd-sourcing data. It fails to meet criteria (a) or (b) as it lacks the specific domain (crowdsourcing) and variables (label validity) required, and it is not a foundational methodology paper (d) specifically for evaluating crowdsourced data quality.
